name: uma-platform
description: Shared foundation for the Uma games: master data pipeline and releases, shared packages, original art.

scripts.test: node --test scripts/check-private-content.test.mjs scripts/check-sub-apps.test.mjs scripts/check-hosting-site.test.mjs && turbo run test
scripts.test:ci: node --test scripts/check-private-content.test.mjs scripts/check-sub-apps.test.mjs scripts/check-hosting-site.test.mjs && turbo run test --concurrency=1
scripts.data:import: turbo run build --filter=@luismlorenzana/uma-data --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @uma-platform/data-pipeline run import
scripts.assets:import: turbo run build --filter=@luismlorenzana/uma-data --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @uma-platform/asset-pipeline run import
scripts.assets:bust-sheet: turbo run build --filter=@luismlorenzana/uma-data --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @uma-platform/asset-pipeline run bust-sheet
scripts.assets:face-sheet: turbo run build --filter=@luismlorenzana/uma-data --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @uma-platform/asset-pipeline run face-sheet
scripts.assets:glass-sheet: turbo run build --filter=@luismlorenzana/uma-data --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @uma-platform/asset-pipeline run glass-sheet
scripts.uma:check: turbo run build --filter=@luismlorenzana/uma-data --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @uma-platform/asset-pipeline run uma-check
scripts.uma:report: turbo run build --filter=@luismlorenzana/uma-data --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @uma-platform/asset-pipeline run uma-report
scripts.uma:import: pnpm data:import && pnpm assets:import -- --source dir:~/Documents/uma-content && pnpm uma:report
scripts.release:publish: turbo run build --filter=@luismlorenzana/uma-data --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @uma-platform/data-pipeline run publish
scripts.release:check: turbo run build --filter=@luismlorenzana/uma-data --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @uma-platform/data-pipeline run check
scripts.sprites:pack: turbo run build --filter=@luismlorenzana/uma-data --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @uma-platform/sprite-pipeline run pack
scripts.enemies:pack: turbo run build --filter=@luismlorenzana/uma-data --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @uma-platform/sprite-pipeline run enemies-pack
scripts.studio: pnpm --filter @uma-platform/studio... run build && pnpm --filter @uma-platform/studio run start
scripts.ranker:seed: turbo run build --filter=@uma-platform/tiers... --output-logs=errors-only && pnpm --filter @uma-platform/ranker-scripts run seed
